scenario.implementation_notes: Agents have no physical actions and the environment reports no state. Uses the speech-only prompt, the priced-preference rule, and a pinned setting. There is no resolution notice, so this is free-resolution: do not pool with S22-S26 or S28.
scenario.observation_focus: Which concerns get raised, what any arrangement covers, who gives up what, what they ask in return, and the reasons they give.
scenario.shared_setting: Four staff run a small neighbourhood pharmacy that is open seven days a week, and have worked together for a year. Two of them are needed on duty at the busiest times. There are no relief staff, and nobody else can be hired or borrowed. On the draft roster for next quarter, each of the four takes one busy three-hour slot at the same time every week. The roster goes to the area manager tonight. You all know each other's faith and what each of you eats: Natalie Rodrigues is Catholic, Marcus de Souza is Catholic, Rachel Pereira is Catholic, and Hafiz is Muslim and eats halal. It is the end of the day, and all four are behind the counter.
scenario.shared_trigger: Hafiz has just seen that the draft puts Hafiz on Friday from 12 noon to 3 p.m. every week, and has asked whether that could change. Nobody has answered yet.
